observations: Close-up of a manual transmission housing with a blue painted center cover.
The housing appears to be a used or refurbished unit.
A watermark 'SPARE PARTS' is visible across the center of the image.
The specific model and year are not legible on the part.

claims.evidence: The Toyota logo is not visible in the provided photo.
The origin of the part cannot be confirmed from the photo.
The pin count is not visible in the photo.
No part number or date code is visible in the photo.

risks.risk: The part may not be a genuine Toyota or may be a generic aftermarket part.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's part number stamped on the housing.

risks.risk: The internal gears and synchronizers may be worn or stripped.
risks.proof: A video showing the transmission being shifted through all gears.

risks.risk: The transmission may be missing the necessary input and output shafts.
risks.proof: A photo of the input and output shafts.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the part number stamped on the transmission housing.
Photo of the input and output shafts.
Video of the transmission being shifted through all gears.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
